\begin{example} \end{example}[Standard Lie Algebras]

↗ prop:8-28

1. ch8:8.36The following are Lie algebras or Lie subalgebras.

  1. $\mathfrak {X}(M)$ with the vector-field bracket.

  2. The smooth left-invariant vector fields on a Lie group $G$.

  3. The $n^2$-dimensional space $\mathfrak {gl}(n,\mathbb {R})=\mathrm{M}(n,\mathbb {R})$ with $[A,B]=AB-BA$.

  4. The real $2n^2$-dimensional space $\mathfrak {gl}(n,\mathbb {C})=\mathrm{M}(n,\mathbb {C})$ with the same bracket.

  5. For a vector space $V$, the space $\mathfrak {gl}(V)$ of endomorphisms, with $[A,B]=A\circ B-B\circ A$; under the standard matrix identification, $\mathfrak {gl}(\mathbb R^n)=\mathfrak {gl}(n,\mathbb R)$.

  6. Any vector space with the zero bracket; such a Lie algebra is abelian.

\end{example}
